SECURITIES COMMISSION MALAYSIA ACT 1993

SECURITIES COMMISSION MALAYSIA (AUDIT OVERSIGHT BOARD) (FEES)
REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 159 of the
Securities Commission Malaysia Act 1993 [ Act 498], the Commission, with the approval
of the Minister, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1)  These regulations may be cited as the Securities Commission Malaysia
(Audit Oversight Board) (Fees) Regulations 2017.

 (2)  These Regulations come into operation on 2 January 2018.

Fees
2. The fees payable in respect of the matters specified in column (2) of the Schedule
shall be as specified in column (3) of the Schedule.

Revocation
3. The Securities Commission (Audit Oversight Board) (Fees) (No. 2)
Regulations 2010 [P.U. (A) 336/2010] are revoked.
